desc:
👋 Welcome to Escape Tsunami on Rollers! 🛼

🌊 A massive tsunami is coming... skate as fast as you can to survive!
🛼 Upgrade your roller skates to gain more speed and overcome huge obstacles!
🏆 Reach the finish to earn Wins and unlock new worlds!
🐾 Collect pets to boost your speed and become the ultimate skater!

👍 Support us by Liking ⭐ and Favoriting ❤️ the game!
